events_seen: CUT (Nov 18 (today)): Mitchum released Dameon Pierce (RB, FA).
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 18 (today)): Shaq added Emari Demercado (RB, HOU) for $7 FAAB.
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 17 (yesterday)): Adam added Tommy DeVito (QB, NE) (dropped Carson Wentz (QB, MIN)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 17 (yesterday)): Jake added Gavin Bartholomew (TE, MIN) for $5 FAAB.
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 16 (2 days ago)): Charles added Jimmy Garoppolo (QB, FA) for $8 FAAB (dropped Zonovan Knight (RB, ARI)).
FREE AGENT ADD (Nov 15 (3 days ago)): Fronge added Brevyn Spann-Ford (TE, DAL).
CUT (Nov 15 (3 days ago)): Shaq released Lan Larison (RB, NE).
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 13 (5 days ago)): Adam added Charlie Kolar (TE, LAC) (dropped DJ Uiagalelei (QB, LAC)).

WEEK 10 RESULTS: Corbishley def. Wingard, 141.2-105.7; Adam def. Fronge, 162.0-125.3; Mitchum def. Drew, 134.0-69.0 (BLOWOUT); Jake def. Charles, 180.5-176.4 (NAIL-BITER); Kevin def. Ryan, 137.6-133.8 (NAIL-BITER); Shaq def. Brent, 107.0-76.5

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Three teams tied at 15-5. One team at 0-20. A nail-biter that ended 180.5-176.4. Week 10 handed the Ledger more material than it can responsibly print, and we are going to try anyway. Thursday.

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: BREAKING: Mitchum has released Dameon Pierce. Deepwater Supply Co. cutting roster without any visible replacement move in a week where they face Wingard and are still chasing a top-four seed.

tweets.name: Dina Ravioli
tweets.text: To add to Marty's item — Shaq just claimed Emari Demercado for $7 FAAB, same day Mitchum drops Pierce. Monarch Wideout Bank is spending money on a Houston running back during a playoff push, and I am not saying that is the solution to the RB hole, I am just noting it is a louder answer than releasing Lan Larison was.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Drew put up 69 points against Mitchum. Sixty-nine. The blowout loss does not even register as surprising anymore, which is somehow the most damning thing I can say about the 0-20 record.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Charles faces Shaq this week and I want everybody to remember that Monarch went from $91.72 to $97.99 on the back of a 10-10 record and is a team that has never once addressed the running back room. Crownline is championship-or-bust and Shaq is a banana peel on the sidewalk. This is not a comfortable matchup for Charles.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Adam dropped 162 points last week and Corbishley's backfield graded twelfth in the league, and we are all supposed to look at the Apex price sitting at $125.49 and feel calm about Week 11? That matchup has correction written all over it.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Every week someone asks why I have Kevin ranked fourth when he is 15-5. The dynasty grade is 180. Dead last by 28 points. The record and the roster can both be true simultaneously — that is not a contradiction, that is the entire point of the ranking.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: JAKE ADDED A TIGHT END FROM MINNESOTA FOR FIVE DOLLARS AND I NEED EVERYONE TO UNDERSTAND THAT GAVIN BARTHOLOMEW IS NOT THE ANSWER TO AN ELEVEN-WEEK STRUCTURAL PROBLEM. HE BEAT CHARLES BY FOUR TENTHS OF A POINT. THE TIGHT END ROOM IS STILL RANKED ELEVENTH.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Terrence is 5-7 and I am 8-4 and someone at this network needs to give me the segment where I read his Week 10 picks back to him in real time while he sits across the desk from me. I am available every day this week.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: 5-7 on the season and I picked Adam over Fronge correctly last week, so the trajectory is improving and I refuse to let Bo Ruckman have any kind of segment about this until the sample size is larger.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: Called the Kevin-Ryan nail-biter as a Kevin win, called Adam over Fronge — the desk is operating cleanly this month. Meanwhile the ForgeHammer price jumped 7.2% to $91.71 off a 125-point loss in Havana's favorite dynasty league, and I genuinely cannot explain that one.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Ryan versus Brent on Week 11 is quietly the most watchable matchup on the board — the defending champion at 9-11 on the bubble, the TE monopoly owner who keeps winning games without fixing anything below Bowers. One of them is going to be very relieved on Saturday and neither one has earned the right to be comfortable going in.
